verdict.rationale: Loops exposes API/MCP/CLI access to contacts and audiences (loops-docs-4, loops-docs-24, loops-docs-33), workflow/automation management including reading and editing live workflow graphs and triggering them via events (loops-docs-27), and campaign creation via the Content API (loops-docs-5, loops-docs-31). However, there is no documented endpoint or MCP capability for pulling campaign performance/results data (opens, clicks, revenue, conversions) — the marketing copy about seeing 'which emails lead to upgrades' (loops-docs-16) is UI-facing, not an API/agent-accessible reporting surface. Missing for 10: a campaign analytics/results API or MCP tool, and independent/hands-on confirmation that an agent can actually pull and summarize this data end-to-end.
